description: This file defines the VisitService interface for the OpenMRS project, specifying method signatures for managing visits, visit types, visit attributes, and related operations within the healthcare system.

classes.name: VisitService
classes.description: Interface for managing patient visits and related entities in the OpenMRS clinical system, including CRUD operations, retrieval with filters, and lifecycle management of visit types and attributes.

methods.name: getAllVisitTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all visit types, with an option to include retired ones.

methods.name: getVisitType
methods.description: Fetches a VisitType by its internal ID.

methods.name: getVisitTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a VisitType by its UUID.

methods.name: getVisitTypes
methods.description: Searches for visit types by a fuzzy name search.

methods.name: saveVisitType
methods.description: Creates or updates a VisitType object.

methods.name: retireVisitType
methods.description: Retires a specific VisitType, optionally with a reason.

methods.name: unretireVisitType
methods.description: Unretires a previously retired VisitType.

methods.name: purgeVisitType
methods.description: Permanently deletes a VisitType from database.

methods.name: getAllVisits
methods.description: Returns all visits that are not voided.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Fetches a Visit by its ID.

methods.name: getVisitByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a Visit by its UUID.

methods.name: saveVisit
methods.description: Creates or updates a Visit record.

methods.name: endVisit
methods.description: Sets stop date/time on a visit to mark it as ended.

methods.name: voidVisit
methods.description: Voids a visit and its encounters, providing a reason.

methods.name: unvoidVisit
methods.description: Reverses a voided visit, unvoiding it and associated encounters.

methods.name: purgeVisit
methods.description: Permanently deletes a visit (not reversible).

methods.name: getVisits
methods.description: Retrieves visits matching multiple filter criteria, including type, location, date ranges, and attributes.

methods.name: getVisits(VisitSearchCriteria)
methods.description: Retrieves visits based on a complex search criteria object.

methods.name: getVisitsByPatient
methods.description: Returns all unvoided visits for a specific patient.

methods.name: getActiveVisitsByPatient
methods.description: Returns all active, unvoided visits for a patient.

methods.name: getVisitsByPatient
methods.description: Returns all visits (including inactive and voided) for a patient.

methods.name: getAllVisitAttributeTypes
methods.description: Lists all VisitAttributeType objects, including retired ones.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Fetches a VisitAttributeType by internal ID.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a VisitAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Creates or updates a VisitAttributeType.

methods.name: retireVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Retires a VisitAttributeType, with reason.

methods.name: unretireVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Unretires a previously retired VisitAttributeType.

methods.name: purgeVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Permanently deletes a VisitAttributeType.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a VisitAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: stopVisits
methods.description: Automatically stops active visits starting before a given date, based on configured visit types.
